intro: Unending Torment is a quest in the Undercity where Master Apothecary Faranell seeks to bind a reassembled captive to the Dark Lady's will. To complete the subjugating concoction, adventurers must gather lethal reagents from across the Forsaken capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.
We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.
We have a potion to make!

clips.title: Progress
paras: It will be ever so lovely to have our lost sheep returned to the fold, don't you think?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These will do nicely. We will see how much bravado our honored guest retains after he is subjected to my masterpiece.
